notes.title: New Game
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

I wanted to share some exciting news I’m working on a brand new game called Metrofall: The Last Human. It’s a dark, atmospheric shooter set deep inside the abandoned metro tunnels of Moscow, where you play as Vasily Sandrovich, the last survivor fighting to uncover the truth and survive against dangerous mutated creatures and robotic insects.

The game will launch first on Epic Games Store, with a Steam release to follow later. I’ll be sharing regular updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and gameplay snippets here, so stay tuned if you want to see how the project develops!

Thanks for all the support can’t wait to show you more soon.

Best Regards 
Jacob Jufeili

notes.title: AMD crash issue has been resolved
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that the AMD crash issue has been fully resolved!

After thorough investigation, I discovered that conflicting files were causing the problem. With that issue now fixed, I’m back to working on all the games, including Backrooms 1995, The Nightmare of Arrival, Forgotten Bunker 1939, and many more.

On top of that, I’m thrilled to reveal that I'm developing a brand-new game, which will be launching on Steam soon! Stay tuned for updates—I'll be releasing demos along the way.

AMD Fix & Game Updates:

All game demos and full versions have been updated to the latest versions, and the AMD crash issue is no more. I've personally tested the fix on my backup PC, which runs an Intel Core i5 7500 CPU, 32GB of DDR4 RAM, a 500W PSU, and an RX 5700XT GPU. Everything ran smoothly—no crashes, and I was able to play for 30 minutes without any issues!

For even better performance, I recommend upgrading to a more powerful GPU, such as the RX 6600 XT or higher. However, even with my current setup, the games performed well, and I was able to reach the main menu and start playing without problems.

notes.title: Update Demo Medkit
notes.notes:
Here is an update that will be coming in a few hours.

I have removed all medkits that you need to pick up and have implemented a new system, similar to Half-Life 2. Now, there are medics on the wall, and you simply run to them to get healed. The best part is, you don’t need to press any buttons to heal! When you run to a medic box, you will be healed instantly, and sometimes, you might even get an additional 30 HP. If you’re lucky, you can go over 230 HP. So, no more medkit packs!

notes.title: Update Demo
notes.notes:
Demo Update,
I watched a video where someone played the demo, so I have fixed some bugs and issues. Here are the updates:

At the start of the game, you will now have a gun, an axe, and a medkit. A prompt will now appear instructing you to pick up items by pressing the "E" button.

I have added functionality for the "H" button to heal when you are hurt.

I have included a tommy gun at the beginning of the second level.

I noticed two monsters that were bugged, so they have been replaced with a new monster/mutant.

If you record demo gameplay on YouTube, I will be watching! It's fun to see people play the game, and I might even leave a comment! =)

That's the update for today. Enjoy!

Best Regards,
LEMIOUTGAMES
Jacob Jufeili
